verdict.rationale: Morph documents dedicated endpoints: you pick a model and plan, Morph provisions and operates the reserved capacity, and you connect through the endpoint's own URL. Endpoint management also appears in the published OpenAPI surface. That covers the core of reserved, isolated capacity, but the evidence never mentions autoscaling or states that traffic is separated from the shared pool. Missing for 10: documented autoscaling behavior, explicit GPU/hardware selection details, explicit statement of traffic isolation from the shared serverless pool, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can deploy a model on dedicated GPU capacity with autoscaling so my traffic is isolated from the shared serverless pool

citations.quote: Reserve model capacity by choosing a model and plan. Morph provisions and operates it; once ready, connect an OpenAI client using the endpoint's URL and served model name.
